summaryZh: Obara 实验室研究细胞生物学和生物物理问题，包括代谢和衰老，并发展跨尺度成像技术。团队结合定量活细胞成像、高分辨率超微结构分析、生化、统计物理和结构生物学。

evidence.quote: Obara Lab@ UC San Diego Integrating technology and biology to link the scales of life. PROJECTS PUBLICATIONS TEAM PI CONTACT The Obara Lab is a team of creative, open-minded individuals working together, trying to address the big questions in cell biology and biophysics. What is life? How does metabolism work? What causes aging? We believe living systems are dynamic, responsive, and inherently complex—and this makes them perfect for quantitative, live cell imaging and high-resolution ultrastructural analysis. Our strategy is developing and integrating the next generation of imaging technologies with classical techniques in biochemistry, statistical physics, and structural biology . We are proud to perform most of our work collaboratively with amazing colleagues and are committed to sharing our tools freely with the wider scientific community. Overview of research projects Projects About our tools Technology Published works from our lab Publications Learn about us Meet our team Philosophy We believe that the truth is inherently worth pursuing, even when inconvenient. We believe that the scientific method is the most reliable way to pursue truth—though our experiments or interpretation can be flawed, the process is inherently self-correcting (eventually). We believe that diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives make us stronger, so we strive to bring new perspectives to the fundamental cellular systems we study. We believe our field is made up of colleagues, not competitors—so we are committed to sharing our data, reagents, and ideas as freely as possible. We believe that thoughtful, open discussion and careful experiments can help us solve many of humanity’s great health challenges—aging, cancer, neurodegenerative diseases—and far beyond.
